sourceFile: 035.MSU - L20S15-07 REPORT TEST CHECK REASON NG HEARING ( +1V ) INCREASE_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it merges unrelated test types and derives defect rates from wrong fields.
issues: Changed factor combines many independent tests into one comparison.
Type 2 Normal is used as baseline for unrelated rows without evidence.
NG counts and rates appear taken from type numbers or wrong columns.
Measurement outcomes are ungrouped header/stat summaries, not valid comparisons.
Evidence rows exist but several cited rows lack needed header/context in the draft.
correctionPlan: Rebuild cases by test type or explicit normal-vs-lot pairs only.
Preserve date, line, type, lot, location, supplier, and condition keys.
Recalculate NG counts/rates from the correct Sigma, +1V, and +0V columns.
Separate functional defect results from dimension/hearing measurements.
Cite header rows plus each compared data row for every outcome.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations mostly exist, but are not sufficient for final evidence until grouping and column mapping are corrected.
